title: Maanasthan
desc: Deiva, a successful farmer and obedient son, is stunned when his father learns he's not his biological child. Betrayed, his father asks him to leave, leading Deiva on a journey of self-discovery.

title: Rajali
desc: A group of adventurers go to an island that is rumoured to have treasure in order to look for it. In their quest they encounter many adversities but try to fulfil their mission.

title: Thedinen Vanthathu
desc: A man and his friend try to save a bag containing a hefty sum, which they hide in an empty house. When they return for the bag, the house is occupied by a girl and her family.

title: Oru Kai Parpom
desc: Jayaraman, a petty thief, changes his ways when he meets a rich lady who is mentally ill and decides to work as her bodyguard.

title: Alexander
desc: CBI officer Alexander investigates a complex case involving murder, smuggling and political corruption. However, his search leads him to a dangerous game of cat and mouse with powerful adversaries.
